sources.title: Quantized KV Cache - vLLM
sources.snippet: Quantized KV Cache FP8 KV Cache Overview Efficient memory usage is crucial for working with large language models. Quantizing the KV (Key-Value) cache to FP8 format can significantly reduce its memory footprint. This optimization enables you to store more tokens in memory, leading to improved throughput and support for longer context windows.
